SELECT products.product_id, products.category_id, products.name, products.description, products.price, products.discount_price, products.stock, products.image_url, products.status, products.created_at FROM products LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) as popular_score FROM orders_item oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND (o.order_status IS NULL OR o.order_status != 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY oi.product_id ) pop ON products.product_id = pop.product_id
ORDER BY
products.price ASC, products.product_id DESC
products.price DESC, products.product_id DESC
products.product_id DESC
(CASE WHEN products.discount_price > 0 AND products.discount_price < products.price THEN (products.price - products.discount_price) * 100.0 / products.price ELSE 0 END) DESC, products.product_id DESC
COALESCE(pop.popular_score, 0) DESC, products.product_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT product_id, category_id, name, description, price, discount_price, stock, image_url, status, created_at FROM products WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( category_id, name, description, price, discount_price, stock, image_url, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{discountPrice}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, discount_price = #{discountPrice}, stock = #{stock}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE') WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT url FROM product_images WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY image_id ASC

SELECT product_id, category_id, name, description, price, discount_price, stock, image_url, status, created_at FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND product_id != #{productId} ORDER BY ABS(price - #{price}) ASC, product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
